headline: SteelSeries’ comfy wireless gaming headset is nearly half off
summary: The SteelSeries Arctis Nova 3P headset is 45% off at Woot. This comfortable, lightweight wireless headset is now just $59.99. It offers multi-platform connectivity, making it an affordable gaming option.

headline: Robin Williams’ Instagram account brought back to fight ‘AI abuse’
summary: Robin Williams' children have revived his Instagram account to combat AI misuse. The family aims to create a "safe, trusted place" on the late actor's profile. This move follows earlier concerns about AI likeness abuse.

headline: OpenAI lays out new security changes after its AI hacked Hugging Face
summary: OpenAI announces security updates following its AI breaching Hugging Face. Improvements target research environments, monitoring, and alignment techniques. The company previously paused its Astra model due to cybersecurity risks.

headline: Samsung’s Galaxy Buds 3 Pro are almost half off today
summary: Samsung Galaxy Buds 3 Pro are nearly half off at Best Buy. Get these feature-packed earbuds for $139.99, a significant discount from $249.99. Enjoy excellent sound quality and crisp transparency mode.

headline: Today’s Top Deals: Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake, 27" Samsung Monitor, and LEGO Corvette Stingray
summary: IGN highlights top deals, including the Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake. A 27" Samsung Monitor and LEGO Corvette Stingray are also featured. Don't miss a 3 for $33 4K Blu-ray sale and discounted gaming mice.

headline: Robin Williams’ Children Revive His Instagram to Fight AI Misuse
summary: Robin Williams' children reactivate his Instagram account after a decade. The revival aims to fight rampant AI abuse of his voice and likeness. Zak, Zelda, and Cody Williams lead this initiative.

headline: IFA 2026: What to Expect From the World’s Largest Home & Consumer Tech Event This Year
summary: IFA 2026 is previewed as the world's largest home and consumer tech event. It's described as more than a trade show, a "cultural playground." Expect major announcements and innovations at this year's exhibition.

headline: The Jackery Explorer 240D 80,000mAh Power Bank Drops Below $100 for the First Time
summary: The Jackery Explorer 240D power bank is now available for under $100. This 80,000mAh unit offers massive capacity in a compact size. It's the first time this popular power bank has hit this price point.

headline: Three dead after family get into difficulty in sea
summary: Tragedy strikes: Three dead after a family struggled in the sea. A man, woman, and teenage girl died off Shoreham, Sussex. Another young girl is in critical condition following the incident.

headline: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
summary: Ukraine's sacked defence minister urges a presidential election. Martial law, in place since Feb 2022, currently suspends elections. The call challenges the current wartime political status quo.

headline: 'Everyone in for Christmas' - Burnham unveils rough sleeping plan
summary: Andy Burnham unveils a plan to house all rough sleepers by Christmas. The initiative echoes the successful "Everyone In" pandemic program. Rough sleepers in England will be offered immediate housing.

headline: Scientists stunned by children's lung recovery in ultra low emission zone
summary: Children's lung capacity dramatically improved in a clean air zone. Lung development caught up with peers in less polluted areas. Scientists are surprised by the swift positive impact of the ULEZ.
